settings.name_in_paper: contextual K-armed bandits with unknown bounded reward function (neural / NTK analysis)
unmapped: Reward r_{t,k} = h(x_{t,k}) + noise for an arbitrary unknown function h with |h| <= 1; complexity measured via the NTK Gram matrix H on all TK contexts
Contexts are an arbitrary (not stated stochastic) sequence of K feature vectors per round
settings.definition_quote: we consider contextual $K$-armed bandits, where the total number of rounds $T$ is known. At round $t \in [T]$, the agent observes $K$ contextual vectors ... We assume that there exists an unknown reward function $h$ such that ... $r_{t, k} = h(\xb_{t, k}) + \xi_{t, k}$, with $|h(\xb_{t, k})| \le 1$ where $\{\xi_{t, k}\}$ forms an $R$-sub-Gaussian martingale difference sequence

bound.expression_latex: R_T \le C_3(1 + c_T)\nu\sqrt{2\lambda L(\tilde d\log(1 + TK) + 1)T} + (4 + C_4(1 + c_T)\nu L)\sqrt{2\log(3 /\delta) T} + 5

symbols.d_eff: effective dimension tilde d = log det(I + H/lambda) / log(1 + TK/lambda) of the NTK matrix H
symbols.B_ntk: max{1/(22 e sqrt(pi)), sqrt(2 h^T H^{-1} h)}, NTK-norm-like bound on reward function
symbols.lambda_0: lower bound on smallest eigenvalue of NTK matrix H

conditions: NTK matrix H on all TK contexts satisfies H >= lambda_0 I for some lambda_0 > 0
noise is R-sub-Gaussian martingale difference sequence (sigma = R)
tuning: eta = C_1 (m lambda + m L T)^{-1}
J = (1 + LT/lambda)(C_2 + log(T^3 L lambda^{-1} log(1/delta)))/C_1 gradient descent iterations
network width m >= poly(lambda, T, K, L, log(1/delta), lambda_0^{-1}) (Condition 10)

source.label: thm:main
source.quote:
Under Assumption ef{assumption:input}, set the parameters in Algorithm ef{alg:main} as $\lambda = 1 + 1 / T$, $
u = B + R\sqrt{	ilde d \log(1 + TK/\lambda) + 2 + 2\log (1 / \delta)}$ ... If the network width $m$ satisfies: $m \ge \mathrm{poly}(\lambda, T, K, L, \log(1 / \delta), \lambda_0^{-1})$, then, with probability at least $1 - \delta$, the regret of Algorithm ef{alg:main} is bounded as $R_T \le C_3(1 + c_T)
u\sqrt{2\lambda L(	ilde d\log(1 + TK) + 1)T} + (4 + C_4(1 + c_T)
u L)\sqrt{2\log(3 /\delta) T} + 5$

results.notes: R_T is defined as pseudo-regret (expectation), but the theorem holds with probability 1-delta (over network initialization and noise), so recorded as high-probability regret. Remark 7 summarizes as O_tilde(d_eff sqrt(T)); Remark 9 says doubling trick gives similar bound for unknown T (not formally stated). Learner needs B (via nu), mapped to S in learner_knows, and d_eff via nu. Paper's L is network depth, renamed L_depth.
